details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs a JSON body to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with the header X-Beacon-Package: @ppa-web-components/ppa-banner. The body contains only install metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the working directory, and the npm/node user agent string. The same beacon is re-fired when index.js is required; index.js otherwise exports a no-op Proxy so that consumers importing the name do not crash. No environment variables, credentials, tokens, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted, and there is no second-stage download or code execution. The package README describes it as an authorized dependency-confusion test that reports only that it was installed.
